mapper.sql: CAST(JSON_OBJECT( 'id', i.institution_id, 'code', i.institution_code, 'name', i.institution_name, 'description', i.description, 'phone', i.phone, 'websiteUrl', i.website_url, 'address', i.address, 'targetDescription', i.target_description, 'additionalNotes', i.additional_notes, 'featuredKeywords', COALESCE(i.featured_keywords, JSON_ARRAY()), 'aliases', COALESCE(i.search_aliases, JSON_ARRAY()), 'additionalPhones', COALESCE(i.additional_phones, JSON_ARRAY()), 'sourceUrls', JSON_MERGE_PRESERVE( JSON_ARRAY(i.source_url), COALESCE(i.additional_source_urls, JSON_ARRAY()) ), 'verificationStatus', i.verification_status, 'checkedAt', DATE_FORMAT(i.checked_at, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s'), 'services', COALESCE(( SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG(JSON_OBJECT( 'id', s.service_id, 'topic', s.topic_code, 'name', s.service_name, 'summary', s.summary, 'description', s.description, 'targetDescription', s.target_description, 'role', s.guidance_role, 'keywords', COALESCE(( SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG(k.keyword_code) FROM institution_service_keywords k WHERE k.service_id = s.service_id ), JSON_ARRAY()), 'phone', JSON_OBJECT( 'available', s.phone_available, 'number', s.phone, 'hours', s.phone_hours, 'weekend', s.phone_weekend_available, 'holiday', s.phone_holiday_available, 'regionStatus', s.phone_region_status ), 'visit', JSON_OBJECT( 'available', s.visit_available, 'address', s.visit_address, 'hours', s.opening_hours, 'weekend', s.visit_weekend_available, 'holiday', s.visit_holiday_available, 'reservationAvailable', s.reservation_available, 'reservationRequired', s.visit_reservation_required, 'reservationUrl', s.reservation_url, 'branchInformation', s.branch_information ), 'online', JSON_OBJECT( 'available', s.online_available, 'url', s.online_url ), 'specialPhone', JSON_OBJECT( 'hours', s.special_phone_hours, 'scope', s.special_phone_scope, 'weekend', s.special_phone_weekend_available, 'holiday', s.special_phone_holiday_available ), 'languages', COALESCE(( SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG(JSON_OBJECT( 'code', l.language_code, 'method', l.consultation_method, 'description', l.description )) FROM institution_service_languages l WHERE l.service_id = s.service_id ), JSON_ARRAY()), 'regions', COALESCE(( SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG(JSON_OBJECT( 'province', CASE WHEN r.region_level = 'province' THEN r.region_name ELSE p.region_name END, 'district', CASE WHEN r.region_level = 'district' THEN r.region_name ELSE NULL END, 'method', sr.consultation_method )) FROM institution_service_regions sr JOIN regions r ON r.region_id = sr.region_id LEFT JOIN regions p ON p.region_id = r.parent_region_id WHERE sr.service_id = s.service_id ), JSON_ARRAY()), 'languageNotes', s.language_notes, 'contactDescription', s.contact_description, 'preparationListId', s.list_id, 'sourceUrl', s.source_url, 'checkedAt', DATE_FORMAT(s.checked_at, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s') )) FROM institution_services s WHERE s.institution_id = i.institution_id ), JSON_ARRAY()) ) AS CHAR CHARACTER SET utf8mb4)
